question: Which of the following statements accurately describes the behavior of 'while True:' when combined with a 'break' statement inside the loop?
options: It will never terminate under any circumstances
It will terminate only if the break statement is executed, otherwise it loops infinitely
It automatically ends after one iteration
It requires an additional 'exit' statement to terminate
correct_answer: It will terminate only if the break statement is executed, otherwise it loops infinitely
